name: Energy-Charts API

provider.name: Fraunhofer Institute for Solar Energy Systems ISE

summary: Keyless JSON API for electricity generation, load, installed capacity, day-ahead prices, cross-border flows and renewable shares for Germany and Europe.
description: The Energy-Charts API from Fraunhofer ISE backs the energy-charts.info site. Endpoints return time series of public net generation by source, total load, installed power, day-ahead spot prices per bidding zone, cross-border electricity trading, grid frequency, a traffic-light signal for green power and renewable share forecasts. Many countries and bidding zones are supported; v1 and /v2 variants of each endpoint exist.

rate_limit.summary: Per client IP and per endpoint (token bucket): 2 requests per minute with a burst of 4; /price 2 per minute with a burst of 2; /signal 20 per minute with a burst of 40. Limits can drop under load; HTTP 429 carries Retry-After.

endpoints.summary: Public net electricity generation and load by source
Day-ahead spot price for a bidding zone
Traffic-light signal for green electricity use
Forecast of the renewable share of load

license.name: CC BY 4.0 unless stated otherwise (price data attributed to Bundesnetzagentur | SMARD.de)

coverage.geographic: Germany and other European countries and bidding zones

agent_notes: Docs and OpenAPI are in English. Timestamps are Unix seconds marking the start of each period (15 minutes for public_power and price on 2026-11-10). A date-only start/end means the full local day. public_power returns a production_types list of {name, data} series aligned to unix_seconds. Use bzn=DE-LU for the German price zone. Honour Retry-After on 429 and cache.
caveats: The rate limit is very low (2 requests per minute per endpoint); batch by wide date ranges and cache.
Access-Control-Allow-Origin was https://www.api.energy-charts.info for both test origins, so browser calls from other sites will fail; call from a server.
Higher limits for commercial access are by arrangement with Fraunhofer ISE (contact in the API description).
The CC BY 4.0 licence applies 'unless stated otherwise'; check license_info in each response.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key; no User-Agent needed.
